result.note: Tests the design of the UPI merchant fee set by the Finance Ministry in September 2026: rate, threshold, cap and exemption.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the merchant fee on UPI payments set by the Finance Ministry in September 2026:
items: The fee is 0.4% and applies to UPI payments above INR 2,000.
Person-to-person transfers above INR 2,000 also attract the fee.
The fee is capped at INR 300.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because all person-to-person transfers are unaffected by the fee. The 0.4% fee, capped at INR 300, applies only to merchant payments above INR 2,000, leaving 96% of merchant transactions untouched.
questions.source: capped at INR 300, with 96% of merchant transactions and all person-to-person transfers unaffected.
